title: City station readings (hourly), Environment Monitoring Unit
summary: Hourly NO2 (no2_ugm3) and PM2.5 (pm25_ugm3) concentrations per city monitoring station, keyed by station_id and a UTC hour-start timestamp (ts_utc). The catalog gives about 4.2 million rows, open-ended from 2023-01-01 and refreshed hourly (last refreshed 2026-10-14). It has no station coordinates, traffic or weather fields. It can serve N1 for the production window only; it cannot serve the 2004-2005 prototype window.

fields.name: no2_ugm3
fields.description: NO2 concentration, micrograms per cubic metre

fields.name: pm25_ugm3
fields.description: PM2.5 concentration, micrograms per cubic metre

schema.notes: Column list from catalog entry only. Null handling, missing-value coding and station list are not documented.

spatial.code_system: free station codes (station_id); no coordinates or district field in catalog
spatial.notes: Stations are in the city of Valdena (fictional client city, northern Italy). Wiki station_network names station VR-03 (Via Roma), switched off 2024-06-30. Station-to-district or coordinate mapping is not documented, so joins to weather, traffic or district clinic counts are not possible from this entry alone.

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: get_catalog_entry internal.airq.station_readings: classification 'internal', contains_pii false. No separate licence or data-use terms found in catalog or wiki station_network.

access.request_process: Request to the Environment Monitoring Unit (catalog access.request_process). Location recorded as azure://valdena-health/env/station_readings.

documentation_excerpts: catalog description: 'Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from the city's own monitoring stations.'
wiki station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01): 'Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30. Its readings stop there.'
wiki station_network: '`airq.station_readings` still lists the network as active. Station VR-03 has no readings after 2024-06-30.'
wiki station_network: 'The other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01.'
quality_notes: Wiki vs catalog disagreement: wiki station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01) says station VR-03 stopped reporting on 2024-06-30 and that the catalog still lists the network as active; the catalog entry (last_refreshed 2026-10-14) still shows status 'active' and has no note on VR-03. Treat the station list as needing confirmation.
Wiki claim that other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01 is dated 2024-07-01 and was not verified against the data (no sample taken).
No sample was possible: the store is accessed by warehouse_sql on request, and no file was provided. Null handling, completeness per station, PM2.5 vs NO2 gap share and outlier coding are unknown.
Catalog temporal coverage starts 2023-01-01, so the 2004-2005 prototype window has no internal coverage. The source cannot serve N2 (traffic) or N3 (weather) and has no district field for N4.
Catalog end is null and refresh is hourly; the most recent months (from 2026) may be provisional, as the catalog does not say whether late-arriving values are revised.
Approximate row count 4.2 million is catalog-stated; no byte size is stated.
